claims.claim: Pupil premium is additional funding for schools in England.
claims.quote: Pupil premium is funding to improve education outcomes for disadvantaged pupils in schools in England.
claims.note: The overview identifies funding for English schools.

claims.claim: The 2026 to 2027 rate is £1,550 per eligible pupil from reception through year 6.
claims.quote: Pupils in year groups reception to year 6 recorded as FSM Ever 6 £1,550
claims.note: The technical note gives this rate and year range.

claims.claim: The 2026 to 2027 rate is £1,100 per eligible pupil in years 7 to 11.
claims.quote: Pupils in years 7 to 11 recorded as FSM Ever 6 £1,100
claims.note: The technical note gives this rate and year range.

claims.claim: The 2026 to 2027 rate is £2,690 for looked-after and previously looked-after children.
claims.quote: Looked-after children ( LAC ) £2,690 Previously looked-after children ( PLAC ) £2,690
claims.note: The technical note gives the same amount for both groups.

claims.claim: From the start of the 2026 to 2027 academic year, all Universal Credit households with children qualify for free school meals.
claims.quote: From the start of the 2026 to 2027 academic year, all children from households receiving Universal Credit are entitled to a free school meal.
claims.note: The free school meal expansion is stated.

claims.claim: Only targeted free school meals under the £7,400 income threshold bring pupil premium, while expanded free school meals do not.
claims.quote: Benefits linked to free school meal eligibility, including pupil premium, will only be available to the Targeted FSM cohort.
claims.note: The same source defines Targeted FSM using the existing £7,400 income threshold.

claims.claim: Parents should make sure the school records their child’s eligibility.
claims.quote: Record each eligible pupil’s FSM category as targeted or expanded in the autumn school census by 2 November 2026.
claims.note: The page tells schools and local authorities to record the category accurately and families to apply, but does not directly instruct parents to check the school record.
